doc: The threshold int(round(256 (1 - c))) uses Python round, HALF TO EVEN, on a value that is exactly k + 0.5 here (c = 1 - (k + 0.5) / 256 is a dyadic float): 0.5 -> 0, 1.5 -> 2, 2.5 -> 2, 3.5 -> 4, 254.5 -> 254, 255.5 -> 256. On the ramp 0..255 the number of True texels is 256 - threshold, so the mask counts are 256, 254, 254, 252, 2, 0 (round-half-up would give 255, 254, 253, 252, 1 and 0).
